bio: Research Overview Publications Contact Us The Lee laboratory studies transposable elements and other types of genomic variations in human disease using computational genomic and bioinformatic approaches. Specifically, we develop and apply computational methods for genomic studies using next-generation sequencing and perform integrative analyses of DNA- and RNA-sequencing data. Duplex-Indel: a Snakemake pipeline for somatic Indel calling in Tn5 transposase-based duplex sequencing data. Bioinformatics. 2026 May 03; 42(5).
